name: RoadSport
meaning: movement, training, sports planning (no medical, no betting)
definition: RoadSport is BlackRoad's sports, movement, practice, choreography, physics, and simulation product. RoadSport is Monte Carlo simulations meets marching band precision meets football. It should replace overpriced, limited sports-video tools with something more useful: route precision, build sheets, player movement, physical constraints, collision logic, practice feedback, and scenario simulation. RoadSport should support player/performer profiles, speed/weight/build attributes, field maps, route/dot books, movement paths, practice feedback, video annotation, formation/choreography, collision simulation, Monte Carlo scenario testing, and football play analysis.
core_promise: Movement should be planned, simulated, practiced, and proven.
